notes: All 30 keywords of the birthday shortlist are now written. Ranks 2 and 3 (birthday date personality test, birthday decoration ideas at home) were HELD on the Phase 0 gate through waves 1 and 2 because no first-party data existed for numerology or physical decoration. They are written here because a second probe of birthdaygfpages on 2026-08-27 measured a field the earlier probe never read — the recorded birthday date, present on 182 of 209 pages — which yields both a lead-time distribution and a numerology birth-number distribution. The gate was satisfied by new data, not overridden.

publishBlockers.detail: Every Devanagari, Tamil, Gujarati, Telugu, Gurmukhi and Urdu string is machine-generated and unverified. Each post records this as a STRUCTURAL audit failure. birthday-wishes-in-urdu counted its exposure precisely at 14 strings and presented NO verse at all, grounding that refusal in Pritchett & Khaliq's Urdu Meter — unlike the 2026-08-25 rakhi Urdu post, which shipped 7 original shers and is still unpublishable. UPDATED FOR WAVE 3: this now affects 15 of the 30 posts. The list is derived from the audit text AND a Unicode-range scan of every body, so it catches posts carrying script examples without a blocker in failed[] — that scan is what caught what-to-write-on-a-birthday-cake in wave 2. birthday-wishes-in-bengali and birthday-wishes-in-kannada are new in wave 3 and there is NO confirmation that a Bengali or Kannada reader is available; birthday-wishes-for-sister-in-law needs one for romanised address forms and register advice rather than for script.

181 birthday posts are live and none appeared in any of the 60 India SERPs harvested. Striking-distance versus indexing cannot be distinguished without a GSC export, and that determines whether these 20 land in the same hole.

publishBlockers.issue: Phase 1 competitor pages not individually fetched
publishBlockers.detail: WebSearch hit its 200/200 session cap before drafting began. SERPs were harvested India-localised (gl=in) in a real browser and supplied per-post, but most top-5 pages were not fetched in full. Recorded per-post in the research briefs.

publishBlockers.issue: conversion fit is weak on two posts
publishBlockers.detail: birthday-songs-for-whatsapp-status (searcher wants an MP3) and the decoration angle are top-of-funnel only. The songs post's own honest assessment says to assume near-zero conversion and treat its ~132 clicks as cluster traffic, not revenue.

publishBlockers.issue: birthday-decoration-ideas-at-home may be the wrong FORMAT for its query
publishBlockers.detail: Its SERP, harvested India-localised on 2026-08-27, returns 7 results: 3 Pinterest boards, 1 YouTube video and 3 commercial decoration services. It is the only keyword in the batch with NO AI Overview and NO informational article ranking anywhere. The intent is images and same-day service, not reading, so a text post fights the intent as well as the incumbents. The post records this against the internal-links item as a structural failure rather than claiming an easy win. Also note the wave-2 shortlist claim 'photojaanic and vaaree prove a blog ranks' is FALSIFIED — neither domain appears in the live harvest.

waves1and2.headline: median personal message 96 characters; 106 of 197 under 100; median build 0.9h; quiz played on only 28 of 195
waves1and2.caveat: no language or relationship field exists, so no per-language or per-relation claim is possible; every post records that absence rather than inventing a figure

wave3.headline: median lead time 0 days; 50.0% of pages created ON the birthday; 62.6% same day or day before; 70.3% within a week; 12.6% created AFTER the birthday had passed
wave3.numerology: mulank (day of month reduced to 1-9) distribution 1:20 2:24 3:19 4:13 5:19 6:20 7:29 8:21 9:17 — chi-square 14.53 on 8 df against a uniform day of month, critical 15.51 at p=.05, so NOT significant. Confirmed on two independent cuts: plausible year of birth 1990-2012 (n=56) gives 14.07, and year stored as the upcoming occurrence (n=126) gives 5.24.
wave3.caveat: Days 1-15 hold only 28.0% of dates where 48.4% is expected, and that skew PERSISTS in the clean year-of-birth subset (32.1%), so it is not explained by launch timing and is not understood. Only 56 of 182 rows carry a plausible year of birth. 32 of 182 (17.6%) have a recorded birthday identical to the page creation date. The data supports the aggregate uniformity finding and NOTHING about any individual number — the numerology post carries an explicit refusal to name a rarest number.

birthday-wishes-for-teacher-in-hindi — same corpus: आप 12,335, तुम 750, तू 236; गुरु 1,103 > शिक्षक 710 > सर 517 > मैडम 192 > महोदय 33 > गुरुजी 18

birthday-wishes-in-punjabi — the same eight wishes measured in Gurmukhi/Shahmukhi/Roman: 31.0/30.3/36.0 code points, 82.8/55.8/36.0 UTF-8 bytes; Roman is longest at +16%
what-to-write-on-a-birthday-cake — derived character budget per cake size: 14 chars on a 500g round, 20 on an 8-inch

birthday-wishes-for-uncle — Leipzig Hindi corpus hin_news_2011_1M (19,177,172 tokens): चाचा 187, अंकल 113, मामा 106, ताऊ 21, मौसा 9, फूफा 5. चाचा:फूफा is 37:1, and the loanword अंकल alone outnumbers ताऊ+मौसा+फूफा combined (35). Self-audited: 9 of the 187 चाचा hits are चाचा नेहरू, 84 of 187 are possessive reference rather than address, and all 21 ताऊ hits were inspected individually.

birthday-wishes-in-kannada — own akshara segmenter over 8 published lines: 86 visible aksharas, 11 ottaksharas (12.8 per 100), font fallback inflates 86 rendered slots to 97 (+12.8%). Romanising costs +27.1% characters, so the 96-character median holds 11.9 Kannada words against 9.3 Roman. Parsed maxp/cmap directly: 361 of 565 glyphs in Kannada MN (63.9%) are unreachable by any character; Devanagari Sangam MN is 82.8% unencoded, so the finding is about Indic fonts generally, not Kannada specifically.

birthday-wishes-in-bengali — own Bengali akshara segmenter: 8 of 8 wishes carry a conjunct and in all 8 it is inside জন্মদিন itself (ন্ম). 1.644 minimal graphemic units per visible akshara, so visible-unit counts understate reading load by 64.4%. 77 of 196 interior cut positions (39.3%) fall inside an akshara against 0 of 242 on the Roman transliterations — a truncation-safety measurement no sibling made. Corrected its own source: the cited paper's secondhand '~85% of all characters' is 87% of the inventory, against a measured 11.9% of running units.

birthday-wishes-for-sister-in-law — two-dictionary lexicographic measurement on dsal.uchicago.edu: Platts (1884) spends 'sister-in-law' across 20 entries, McGregor (1993) across 9, and NEITHER gives jethani or devrani that gloss, spelling out the route through the family instead. Both tag address vs reference on the page (intj. on bībī-jī, voc. on jījī, 'reference' on nanad), and McGregor's -ānī entry shows her rank derives from her husband's birth order, not her age.

birthday-number-meaning-numerology — reframed the first-party chi-square with the belief literature: numerological belief shifts CHOSEN dates by 25-39% (Danish wedding dates, Saint Petersburg floor 13, Chinese-American auspicious birth dates) but GIVEN dates by about 2%, which is why the site's own measured distribution is flat.
